text:
You're not needy in relationships. You're acting out childhood wounds.

Cold father. Unpredictable mother. You learned love meant proving yourself or never needing anyone.

Now you chase unavailable women. You can't set boundaries. You break when she pulls away.

This isn't weakness. It's a wound playing out.

Trace it back. What did they teach you about your own worth?

Work through it. Do it or repeat their mistakes.

Start today: one honest question. Where did this come from?
caption:
Your patterns aren't personality. They're inherited wounds from people who couldn't handle their own stuff.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
